_help: Weekly flyers publish automatically in America/New_York time; no daily uploads. To replace one day, add an entry to "flyers" with: date (YYYY-MM-DD, Eastern), title, src (/assets/flyers/your-file.webp), and optional publishAt (24-hour HH:MM, defaults to settings), time (event hours), lead (description), reserve (https link). To close one date add {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "closed": true}. Tuesdays are closed unless the entry has "open": true. One entry per date. See /assets/flyers/README.md.
